proposed_comments.title: Keep pinned access keys stable when recents come first

confidence.rationale: The current implementation derives shortcuts from visual append order, and the before-pinned branch deterministically shifts configured pin digits.

proposed_comments.title: Reserve configured pins beyond the display limit

confidence.rationale: The early break leaves later configured pins absent from both ownership sets; the resolver test directly demonstrates their reappearance.

proposed_comments.title: Keep pinned commands in the pinned section

confidence.rationale: The recent-first branch resolves history before pins, so the shared featured set deterministically assigns a recently used pin to the wrong section.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize invalid persisted placement values

confidence.rationale: System.Text.Json accepts undefined numeric enum values, and the two consumers handle those values inconsistently.

proposed_comments.title: Enforce the shelf-specific five-item limit

confidence.rationale: The shared limit is 10 and is passed directly to the shelf despite the PR description explicitly promising at most five.

proposed_comments.body:
### Enforce the shelf-specific five-item limit

**Severity:** `medium`

The PR promises at most five recent shelf items, but the shared setting allows ten and is passed directly into this configuration. Clamp the compact shelf independently so Home can retain its 1–10 setting without exceeding the shelf contract.

```suggestion
            Math.Clamp(
                recentCommandLimit,
                SettingsModel.MinRecentCommandsDisplayLimit,
                5));
```

proposed_comments.title: Describe the stable pinned shortcut order

confidence.rationale: The current string says left-to-right while the corrected stable assignment is based on pinned order.

proposed_comments.body:
### Describe the stable pinned shortcut order

**Severity:** `low`

After pinned shortcuts are made stable, they no longer follow visual left-to-right order when recents appear first. Update the help text so users are told the actual shortcut assignment.

```suggestion
    <value>Shows quick access commands below the search box while compact mode is collapsed. Pinned commands keep Alt+1 through Alt+9 in pinned order, recent commands use any remaining shortcuts, and Alt+0 opens overflow.</value>
```

proposed_comments.title: Clarify that the shelf stops at five recent items

confidence.rationale: The current string states the 1-10 selection applies to the shelf, contradicting the explicit five-item shelf requirement.

proposed_comments.body:
### Clarify that the shelf stops at five recent items

**Severity:** `low`

Once the shelf is capped at five, values 6–10 affect Home only. The current text says the full selected limit applies to both surfaces, so make the shelf-specific cap explicit.

```suggestion
    <value>Choose how many recently used commands and launched apps, from 1 through 10, can appear on Home. The quick access shelf shows at most five.</value>
```

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the originating provider context for recent commands

confidence.rationale: RecentCommandListItem is passed as command context while the host service recognizes only TopLevelViewModel, causing deterministic fallback to the wrong host/context.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the originating provider context for recent commands

**Severity:** `high`

Home wraps recent top-level items in `RecentCommandListItem`, but host and provider-context lookup only recognizes a direct `TopLevelViewModel`. Recent commands from an extension can therefore create pages or invoke commands under the root/current host instead of their originating extension; unwrap `RecentCommandListItem.Source` in `PowerToysAppHostService.GetHostForCommand` and `GetProviderContextForCommand`, with an invocation regression test. This service is outside the current diff, so GitHub cannot render this as an apply-ready inline suggestion.
